name: Last Couple Minutes
source:
Play the role of Lin as she struggles to figure out what’s wrong with her boyfriend, Vince, while problems arise in their relationship and their 'own little world.' But be forewarned – it’s impossible for things to end well.

[From [url=https://tokkimeki.itch.io/last-couple-minutes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演林的角色，她努力找出男友文斯出了什么问题，而他们的关系和“自己的小世界”也出现了问题。但请预先警告——事情不可能有好结果。

[来自[url=https://tokkimeki.itch.io/last-couple-minutes]Itch.io[/url]]
